parsed.note_claim: That photo does not show Queen Elizabeth & Prince Philip bowing for Haile Selassie I, but unidentified guests bowing at an event that happened years before the British Royal family even visited Ethiopia.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Queen Elizabeth II simply cannot be in those two photos , because they were not visiting Ethiopia in 1955.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the photos date from 1955, states the Queen's visit was in 1965, and explicitly denies her presence in the images.
